channel.title: Sound baths in Fort Collins · Sound Bath Calendar
channel.description: A weekly-updated calendar of sound baths in Fort Collins, Colorado: dates, times, venues, prices, and ticket links for every listed session. Part of the Front Range sound bath calendar.

item.title: Thursday Mind Body Reset — Gong Journey
item.description: A weekly Thursday gong journey played on multiple large gongs including Iris, a five-foot handcrafted gong, at Rocky Mountain Restore & Stretch on Soderburg Drive, Fort Collins; $45. Where: Rocky Mountain Restore & Stretch LLC, Fort Collins. Price: $45. Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/thursday-mind-body-reset-gong-journey-2026-09-10-rocky-mountain-restore-stretch-llc/

item.title: Thursday's Weekly Gong Journey
item.description: Recurring weekly evening gong sound bath using a large healing gong for nervous-system reset. Where: Rocky Mountain Restore & Stretch, Fort Collins. Price: $40. Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/thursdays-weekly-gong-journey-2026-09-10-rocky-mountain-restore-stretch/

item.title: New Moon Soundbath
item.description: A new-moon sound bath led by Zach Miller at Seedlings Outdoor Learning, 101 Hartman St in Fort Collins, Thursday evening; $29-34. Where: Seedlings Outdoor Learning, Fort Collins. Price: $29–34. Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/new-moon-soundbath-2026-09-10-seedlings-outdoor-learning/

item.title: Alchemy of Balance: New Moon Sound Journey
item.description: Annmarie of ResoundingWell hosts a new-moon sound journey with Tibetan singing bowls, planetary gong, and crystal bowls at Live Beyond Limit in Fort Collins, Friday evening; $39.19-$44.52. Where: Live Beyond Limit, Fort Collins. Price: $39.19-$44.52. Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/alchemy-of-balance-new-moon-sound-journey-2026-09-11-live-beyond-limit/

item.title: Soothing Sound Bath and Gentle Yoga with Melinda
item.description: Melinda Boddicker leads a sound meditation into gentle yoga flow and closing sound bath at Shelter 7 in City Park, part of Noco Moon Market's last-of-season Fort Collins evening market, Friday night; $25. Where: Shelter 7, Fort Collins. Price: $25. Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/soothing-sound-bath-and-gentle-yoga-with-melinda-2026-09-11-shelter-7/

item.title: Second Saturday Sound Bath, Meditation & Community Circle
item.description: Coach Sage of Citrine Unlimited leads a monthly 50-minute sound bath and guided meditation with crystal bowls and tongue drum at Brookstone Recreation Center in Loveland (Fort Collins area), second Saturdays; donation-based. Where: Brookstone Recreation Center, Fort Collins. Price: Donation. Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/second-saturday-sound-bath-meditation-community-circle-2026-09-12-brookstone-recreation-center/

item.title: Sunday Morning of Sound Gong Journey - Horsetooth Reservoir
item.description: An outdoor gong journey held at Horsetooth Reservoir just west of Fort Collins, featuring multiple large gongs including the 5-foot 'Iris'. This is very likely the same instance also listed on Eventbrite as 'Sundays of Sound -Mind Body Reset Gong Journey' (identical date, time and description), which gives the studio's street address rather than the reservoir meeting point; the operator's own page states the location plainly as Horsetooth Reservoir. Where: Horsetooth Reservoir, Fort Collins. Price: $42 drop-in ($47 hip & back saver upgrade). Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/sunday-morning-of-sound-gong-journey-horsetooth-reservoir-2026-09-13-horsetooth-reservoir/

item.title: Weekly Sound Bath & Meditation with Joe
item.description: Joe Ritter, a sound practitioner and meditation teacher whose practice is called Rhythmic Alchemy, leads a weekly Sunday-evening sound bath and guided meditation with handmade bowls at The Movement Apothecary. The Visit Fort Collins listing marks this as recurring weekly on Sunday. Where: The Movement Apothecary, Fort Collins. Price: $25 drop-in. Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/weekly-sound-bath-meditation-with-joe-2026-09-13-the-movement-apothecary/
